title: Position of Parts of Speech (Ques. No. 101-150)
subtopic: Position of Parts of Speech (236 Marks)

questions.question:
The work will <u>double</u> your income.
I shall <u>call</u> you on Friday.
I will immediately <u>water</u> the plants.
You may <u>water</u> on the plant.[]
questions.explanation:
double / call / water → Verb
Trick: Subject + action → Verb
Or modal verb(will) এরপর main verb বসে

questions.question:
I cannot <u>right</u> the wrong.
A man cannot <u>undergo</u> two trials for the same crime.[]
questions.explanation:
right / undergo → Verb
Trick: noun থেকেও action হলে → Verb
(right = correct করা)

questions.question:
Can you <u>smell</u> gas ?
A man cannot <u>undergo</u> two trials for the same crime.[]
questions.explanation:
smell / undergo → Verb
Trick: subject + action → Verb

questions.question:
Come on, it's time to go <u>home</u>.
They went <u>home</u> last night.
They returned <u>home</u> earlier.
What time did he get <u>home</u> last night ?[]
questions.explanation:
home → Adverb
Trick: go / come / return / get + home → Adverb (no preposition)

questions.question: The mother sat vigilantly beside the sick baby. Here '<u>vigilantly</u>' is ---[]
questions.explanation:
vigilantly → Adverb
Trick: -ly ending → usually adverb

questions.question: Man cannot live <u>alone</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
alone → Adverb
Trick: verb (live) কে modify করছে

questions.question:
He works <u>hard</u>.
You should work <u>hard</u>.
He works <u>hard</u> all day round.
He works <u>hard</u> to manage the hard work.[]
questions.explanation:
hard → Adverb
Trick: work/run/study + hard → Adverb

questions.question:
The boys moved <u>fast</u> to save the child from drowning.
How <u>fast</u> the boy runs !
He runs <u>fast</u>.
He walks <u>fast</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
slowly / early → Adverb
Trick: verb কে modify করছে

questions.question:
Please speak <u>slowly</u>.
The bird flies <u>slowly</u>.
He started <u>early</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
slowly / early → Adverb
Trick: verb কে modify করছে
-ly suffix

questions.question:
The accident took place long <u>ago</u>.
Thank you <u>very</u> much.[]
questions.explanation:
long ago / much → Adverb
Trick: time বা degree বোঝালে → Adverb

questions.question:
The girl dances <u>nicely</u>.
The bird sings <u>sweetly</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
nicely / sweetly → Adverb
Trick: -ly suffix → Adverb

questions.question:
He has done ----- in the examination.
I found out that Rahim did ----- in the test.
The corrections were made -----.[]
questions.explanation:
badly → Adverb
Trick: do + adverb (action কেমন হয়েছে বোঝায়)

questions.question: The programme was telecast/broadcast <u>live.</u> Here 'live' is ---[]
questions.explanation:
live → Adverb
Trick: verb + live (broadcast/telecast live)

questions.question: His grades have improved, but only -----.[]
questions.explanation:
very slightly → Adverb phrase
Trick: verb improved কে modify করছে

questions.question: "Well' is usually an adverb and so describe -----, but when it refers to health it can be an adjective and describe -----.[]
questions.explanation:
well → Adverb / Adjective
Adverb: verb describe করে
Adjective: health বোঝায়
Trick:
write/run well → Adverb
feel well → Adjective

questions.question: There are two types of verbs, action verbs and ----- verbs.[]
questions.explanation:
linking → Verb type
Trick: verb দুই ধরনের
Action verb
Linking verb

questions.question: I know <u>better</u>. The underlined word is ---[]
questions.explanation:
better → Adverb
Trick: verb know কে modify করছে

questions.question:
He came <u>close</u> to me.
He did not want to arrive <u>late.</u>
The flight arrived <u>late.</u>
He came <u>late.</u>[]
questions.explanation:
close / late → Adverb
Trick: verb came / arrived কে modify করছে

questions.question: I know that he is <u>well.</u>[]
questions.explanation:
well → Adjective
Trick: be verb + adjective

questions.question: The boy writes well. Here 'well' is a/an ---[]
questions.explanation:
well → Adverb
Trick: write + well (verb describe)

questions.question:
The patient visits the doctor <u>once</u> a month.
I have read the novel <u>twice.</u>[]
questions.explanation:
once / twice → Adverb
Trick: frequency বোঝালে → Adverb

questions.question:
People like him <u>little.</u>
I have done the work <u>well.</u>
He reached home <u>safely.</u>[]
questions.explanation:
little / well / safely → Adverb
Trick: verb (like / done / reached) কে modify করছে

questions.question: <u>Down</u> went the Titanic.[]
questions.explanation:
Down went the Titanic → Adverb
Trick: movement direction বোঝালে (up/down/out/in) → Adverb

questions.question: He doesn't like Beethoven and neither do I. In this sentence 'neither' is ---[]
questions.explanation:
neither → Adverb
Trick: negative agreement (neither do I)

questions.question: <u>Hardly</u> do I go to the New Market. The underlined word is ---[]
questions.explanation:
hardly → Adverb
Trick: negative sense + inversion (Hardly do I…)
-ly suffix

questions.question: When you can say you can do this, <u>well</u> prove this.[]
questions.explanation:
well → Adverb
Trick: verb prove কে modify করছে

questions.question: Jeans are nowadays <u>in</u> across the globe. Here 'in' is ---[]
questions.explanation:
in → Adjective
Trick: fashion sense
in = fashionable / trendy

questions.question: The boys went <u>inside</u> to eat dinner.[]
questions.explanation:
inside → Adverb
Trick: verb went এর direction

questions.question: Suddenly one of the wheels came <u>off</u>. []
questions.explanation:
suddenly → Adverb
Trick: action কিভাবে হলো বোঝালে → Adverb
-ly suffix

questions.question:
The sun has gone <u>down</u>.
The price of essentials has gone <u>down</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
down → Adverb
Trick: verb + down (gone down)

questions.question: The <u>more</u> you read, the more you learn.[]
questions.explanation:
the more you read → Adverb
Trick: more + verb (degree বোঝায়) → Adverb

questions.question: Akbar <u>still</u> works in that office.[]
questions.explanation:
still works → Adverb
Trick: verb কে modify করলে → Adverb

questions.question: I <u>already</u> told him about the party.[]
questions.explanation:
already told → Adverb
Trick: time বোঝালে (already, just, yet) → Adverb

questions.question:
Rahim always runs quite fast. Here 'always' is ---
He <u>always</u> tells the truth.[]
questions.explanation:
always runs / tells → Adverb
Trick: frequency word → Adverb
(always, often, usually, sometimes)

questions.question: I rather like the smell of petrol,'rather' is ---[]
questions.explanation:
rather like → Adverb
Trick: degree বোঝালে → Adverb (rather, quite, very

questions.question: He has <u>already</u> finished his homework.[]
questions.explanation:
already finished → Adverb
Trick: time word (already, just, yet) → Adverb

questions.question:
I <u>usually</u> get up early.
He <u>hardly</u> goes to his native village.[]
questions.explanation:
usually / hardly → Adverb
Trick: frequency / degree word → Adverb

questions.question:
Barking dogs <u>seldom</u> bite.
I <u>seldom</u> go to cinema.[]
questions.explanation:
seldom → Adverb
Trick: frequency বোঝায় (rarely)

questions.question:
It is <u>best</u> analyzed in Samuelson.
He was <u>gravely</u> concerned about the problem.[]
questions.explanation:
best / gravely → Adverb
Trick: verb কে modify করছে (analyzed / concerned)

questions.question: He is little known. Here 'little' is ---[]
questions.explanation:
little known → Adverb
Trick: adverb + past participle (little / well / widely known)

questions.question: Sohan may <u>yet</u> surprise us all.[]
questions.explanation:
yet surprise → Adverb
Trick: yet / still / already → verb modify করে

questions.question: Which one is correct ?[]
options: She arrives always late in the morning.
questions.explanation:
Judy often reads magazines
Trick: frequency adverb (often, always) → subject এর পরে

questions.question: Which position of 'always' is correct ?[]
options: Always the old man enjoys watching television at weekends.
The old man enjoys watching always television at weekends.
The old man enjoys always watching television at weekends.
The old man always enjoys watching television at weekends.
questions.explanation:
✔ The old man always enjoys watching television
Trick: subject + always + main verb

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence :[]
options: We had always to wear a uniform at school.
We always had to wear an uniform at school.
We always had to wear a uniform at school.
We had always wear uniform to school.
questions.explanation:
✔ We always had to wear a uniform
Trick: always → subject এর পরে

questions.question: He ----------.[]
options: catches always the train at 7.30 a.m
catch always the train at 7.30 a.m
always catches the train at 7.30 a.m
always catch the train at 7.30 a.m
questions.explanation:
Q45
✔ always catches the train
Trick: always + verb
subject = he → catches

questions.question: <u>Sometimes</u> reports are misleading.[]
questions.explanation:
Sometimes reports → Adverb
Trick: time/frequency word → Adverb

questions.question: I can't tell you <u>how</u> I did it.[]
questions.explanation:
how I did it → Adverb
Trick: how → verb describe করে

questions.question: The wearer knows <u>where</u> the shoe pinches.[]
questions.explanation:
where the shoe pinches → Relative pronoun
Trick: clause introduce করলে → Relative pronoun

questions.question: <u>Beyond</u> the river lay a little village.[]
questions.explanation:
Beyond the river → Preposition
Trick: preposition + noun

questions.question: She said that she will be in the classroom <u>by</u> 8 a.m.[]
questions.explanation:
by 8 a.m. → Preposition
Trick: by + time → Preposition
